audit_items.proof_trace: Migration 0001_create_attendance_schema.sql L10 sets `ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA attendance GRANT ALL ON FUNCTIONS TO anon`. The security-fix migration 20260317000001 revokes the default for TABLES (L90) but contains no corresponding `ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA attendance REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTIONS FROM anon` — confirmed by grep across all migrations. The property assertion fails for FUNCTIONS: the default privilege still grants ALL to anon, violating `default_privileges(attendance, anon, FUNCTIONS) == NONE`. Existing function `attendance.record_attendance_by_card` (created at 20260317000000, before the fix) inherited this ALL grant and was never explicitly revoked.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Any future function created in the `attendance` schema (e.g., admin utility, reporting RPC) automatically inherits ALL privileges for `anon`, making it callable by unauthenticated HTTP clients via Supabase's PostgREST `/rpc/<function>` endpoint without authentication.
